sourceScope: Prospectively captured PTT Stock [標的] posts or equivalent public posts with explicit directional forecast plus explicit confidence/performance language.
parentEligibility: post captured under append-only PTT source contract
direction is explicit from structured post field/title or remains UNKNOWN
forecast horizon/target/stop is explicit where used; no inferred hidden horizon
confidence evidence must be explicit text, not inferred from turnover, returns, posting frequency or leverage

secondary: forecast error conditional on frozen horizon
futureEvaluation.guard: No future outcome enters the parent. No post-outcome threshold tuning.

privacyGuard.rule: No named-user overconfidence score, ranking or persistent psychology profile.
privacyGuard.handles: May be used transiently only for duplicate-post control; not persisted in derived behavioral outputs.

falsification: Public statements can be strategic, performative or sarcastic rather than faithful private belief.
Self-reported hit rate can be selective or unverifiable.
Forecast accuracy is not overconfidence unless paired with explicit confidence/uncertainty evidence.
Forum posters are selected and not representative of all Taiwan investors.
This lane does not prove actual trading behavior.

ownershipFirewall.sharedPrimitiveRule: Same PTT post may support controls, but no multiple independent selection votes.

l4Requirement: Only posts first captured after a separate L4 preregistration extension may count as prospective evidence; require frozen confidence classes, horizon rules and aggregate-only evaluation.
